subject: Misallocated usage buckets on Q2 invoices — request for retroactive adjustment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, billing@brightlane.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Misallocated usage buckets on Q2 invoices — request for retroactive adjustment

Hi Marcus,

We're seeing a sizable overage on invoice INV-20270601 and after digging into our export we discovered that around 1.2M tokens of self-serve batch processing were billed to the "streaming/low-latency" bucket instead of the contracted batch bucket. That misallocation pushed us above our committed threshold and created an unexpected $18,350 overage charge.

I've attached our usage CSV and a short delta summary (brightlane_usage_q2.csv). Can Redwood review and confirm whether these tokens can be reclassified back to batch for billing purposes? If so, we'd like a retroactive adjustment/credit for the overage on INV-20270601. Our quarter close is next week, so a timeline would be appreciated.

For context: BrightLane has been on the Standard commit (S-2) since Jan 2027. We think this is an ingestion/route-mapping issue from the Connector v1.3.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance, BrightLane AI
(attachment: brightlane_usage_q2.csv, type: text/csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Misallocated usage buckets on Q2 invoices — request for retroactive adjustment

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the CSV. I pulled this into a quick check with our routing and billing teams.

Short answers up front: we will (1) pause any collection activity related to INV-20270601 while we investigate, and (2) run a delta analysis to validate whether the 1.2M tokens were incorrectly binned.

Can you confirm the signed attestation below (a brief one-line from your finance team stating these rows represent BrightLane production usage)? That will help our finance team expedite a credit memo if we agree. Also cc'ing Laura from Revenue Ops and Naomi from Technical Support to coordinate.

Next steps from us:
- Naomi will pull server-side routing logs for the date ranges you flagged and produce a bucket-mapping diff.
- Aditya will align with the Connector team to confirm whether v1.3 had a routing rule regression.
- Laura will scope any credit (policy + accounting entries) once the delta is validated.

I expect an initial status update by EOD tomorrow. If this moves faster we'll let you know.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Misallocated usage buckets on Q2 invoices — request for retroactive adjustment

Hi Elena — Laura from Revenue Ops here. Thanks for sending the CSV and Marcus for the triage plan.

Quick accounting note: policy allows us to issue retroactive credits for demonstrable misbilling caused by Redwood routing or bucket misclassification. To process a credit memo we need:
- Signed attestation from BrightLane finance confirming the highlighted rows in brightlane_usage_q2.csv represent production usage and are eligible for reclassification (a short PDF is fine),
- A delta spreadsheet showing original invoice lines vs. proposed re-binning (we've attached a template: redwood_delta_analysis.xlsx), and
- Agreement on the credit memo remit (apply to INV-20270601 or issue as separate credit to be applied to next invoice).

Given your timeline we can provisionally offer a goodwill concession: if our technical check confirms Redwood routing caused the misallocation, finance can approve an uplifted credit up to 30% above the calculated billing delta to cover any reconciliation overhead. We will of course only issue the final number after the validation.

I've placed INV-20270601 on hold for collections while we complete the review. Please confirm if you prefer (A) apply credit to INV-20270601 or (B) issue a credit memo to be applied to the next statement.

(attachment: redwood_delta_analysis.xlsx)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Misallocated usage buckets on Q2 invoices — request for retroactive adjustment

Hi Laura and team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per your list I've attached a signed attestation (signed_usage_attestation.pdf) and completed your delta template with our view. We prefer option A (apply to INV-20270601) to keep our quarter clean.

Please confirm when you have the technical validation. We appreciate the provisional goodwill uplift — that will make reconciliation much smoother.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance, BrightLane AI
(attachment: signed_usage_attestation.pdf, type: application/pdf)
